Package com.bupt.ta.model

Class Application

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.model.Application
public class Application extends Object
Represents a TA job application submitted by a student for a specific module and role.

Instances are serialized to WEB-INF/data/applications.json and loaded by ApplicationService. Public fields are used for JSON binding; mutating a loaded instance does not persist until the service writes the file back.

Not thread-safe: each request typically works with its own instances or service-level synchronization when updating the shared JSON store.
